author.bio: The earliest located related wording was preserved by teacher Jess Lair in a book of reflections that included his students’ unsigned classroom cards. Lair did not require original composition or attribution, so neither he nor the unnamed submitter can safely be credited as the creator. Richard Bach, the novelist and pilot associated with this popular version, is not supported by the located evidence.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Lair collected brief cards from students and discussed them at the start of class; he did not require the words to be original. The saying then circulated in shorter forms, including Peter Max’s 1972 syndicated comic credited to Unknown, so the history concerns a family of variants rather than one established author’s exact sentence.
